title: examples/app-todo: the manual `test:mcp` script fails at step 3 on main ("Organization is required"), and no lane runs it
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cymvo9YoyLwKCXXBNw

Filing gate: ① defect, named location. This is an out-of-scope finding of the #30804 PR 2 dev work (os-dev-report 6684399669 on #30804, PR #30927). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

**Business reason.** `examples/app-todo` ships a manual MCP end-to-end script that is meant to prove the todo app's actions work over MCP. It fails on `main`, and nothing runs it, so a regression on that path stays invisible and anyone who follows the script gets a red they did not cause.

## What happens

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo test:mcp` (`tsx test/mcp-actions.e2e.ts`, `examples/app-todo/package.json:20`) exits 1 at its step 3 on `main` `1697d5ca9`. Steps 1 and 2 pass. The seed and the step-3 insert both fail with `Organization is required`, because the script boots without an organization. The renames in PR #30927 do not change this: the script fails the same way before and after them.

No workflow or package script runs `test:mcp`, so CI never sees it.

## Wanted

- Make the script boot with an organization (or seed under the system context the other example e2e boots use), so all its steps pass on `main`.
- Then either wire it into a lane that runs (an example or dogfood suite), or delete it if another test already covers the same MCP action path. Name which one in the PR.

Suggested grade: p3. The script is manual, and the product path it exercises may be covered elsewhere.
